thread:
Ravi (Finance): Quick note 99vendor promo credits (POOL-VPR-2026) expire in 6 days. Balance shows 2.2M GPU-min. We should reassign or fire off planned runs. @Lina can you see eligibility?

Lina (Billing): credits-bot already surfaced it. Eligible scopes: teams/*, projects/benchmarks, infra/shared-temp. We can split but need documented approval chain. Also one of the credits lines was imported without the "cost_center" tag; that will block attribution unless we patch it.

credits-bot: NOTICE 9POOL-VPR-2026 expires in 6 days. Remaining: 2,200,000 GPU-minutes. Unassigned portion: 320,000. Link: https://billing.internal/credits/POOL-VPR-2026

Jordan (Platform): We can push 600k to projects/benchmarks for Nora's prealpha sweep and 1.2M to infra/shared-temp. That leaves 400k unassigned; we should decide fast.

Sam (Infra Eng): If infra/shared-temp gets 1.2M it will apply to spot reclaim jobs. But as Lina said, missing cost_center tag on 320k will appear as "unattributed" and get quarantined. Billing needs to patch the tag before transfer.

Nora (ML Research): We have a grid sweep scheduled for Monday-Wed that would consume ~550k; OK to take 600k. Please tag as cost_center=ml-research and project=prealpha-sweep.

Priya (Eng Lead): Approvals needed: cost center owner (ml-research) approves Nora, infra owner approves Sam, finance approves Ravi. We can do approvals in-thread.

Ravi (Finance): Approve the proposed split subject to tags being fixed and an audit note. Justification: "use vendor promo credits before expiry for scheduled benchmarking and cluster backlog."

Nora (ML Research): Approved. Justification: "prealpha model sweep for eval and feature gating". :white_check_mark:

Sam (Infra Eng): Approved for infra/shared-temp. Justification: "absorb spot backlog and keep cluster busy." :white_check_mark:

Lina (Billing): I'll repair the missing tag on the 320k chunk and then run the transfer. Command I will use (internal CLI):

```
billingctl transfer --pool POOL-VPR-2026 --alloc "projects/benchmarks:600000,infra/shared-temp:1200000,projects/research:400000" --apply-audit-tag POOL-VPR-2026 --patch-tag missing_cost_center=internal-temp
```

Lina (Billing): Creating JIRA FIN-POOL-2981 to track. ETA transfer 1h after approvals. I'll attach all approver messages.

credits-bot: TRANSFER SCHEDULED 9ID TR-POOL-2981 scheduled by Lina. Pending execution.

Jordan (Platform): Also adding a temporary metric so we can spot if consumption lags: monitor.billing.pool.POOL-VPR-2026.consumed_pct < 50% over 48h -> alert #finance #platform. SQL to check consumption by tag for the last 7d:

```
SELECT cost_center, project, sum(gpu_minutes) as consumed
FROM usage.billing
WHERE pool_tag = 'POOL-VPR-2026' AND timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY cost_center, project
ORDER BY consumed DESC;
```

Lina (Billing): Transfer executed. TR-POOL-2981 complete. Allocations: projects/benchmarks:600000, infra/shared-temp:1200000, projects/research:400000. Missing tag patch applied: missing_cost_center=internal-temp. Audit tag: POOL-VPR-2026.

credits-bot: NOTICE 9TRANSFER COMPLETE TR-POOL-2981. Remaining unallocated: 0.

Priya (Eng Lead): Thanks. Request: can we add a short postmortem if more than 20% of allocations are unused at expiry? Helps tighten process.

Ravi (Finance): Agreed. Lina, please leave a usage report in FIN-POOL-2981 after 72h and mark for review.

Lina (Billing): Will do. I'll post consumption snapshot and link to JIRA.

Sam (Infra Eng): One FYI: infra shared attribution will show as infra/shared-temp in billing exports; I'll add a mapping to tag jobs with the originating team where possible.

Nora (ML Research): Kicking off sweep now. Will ping with final consumption numbers.

credits-bot: ALERT 9Monitor created: monitor.billing.pool.POOL-VPR-2026.consumed_pct under 50% -> #finance #platform.
